findings.summary: Session tokens come from random.choice (Mersenne Twister): predictable, so sessions can be guessed.
A failed login logs the password in plain text (often the user's real password with a typo).
The expiry test is inverted: fresh sessions are dropped and expired ones stay valid forever.
Five wrong passwords lock an account for good: anyone can lock out any member.
findings.suggested_fix: Lock for a limited time and reset the counter after it.

findings.summary: The clock parameter has no type annotation.
